plain_language_revision.target: Sixth-grade authored prose; common English vocabulary, with necessary terms explained.
plain_language_revision.method: Flesch-Kincaid advisory score; wordfreq English top4000 exact word forms (inflections, proper names and legal terms also flagged). Static text excludes code/URLs/variable expressions; branch prose combined; short labels affect scores. Read screen text and justify exceptions; not proof of comprehension.
plain_language_revision.checker: DAYamlChecker --style --style-review-level thorough --no-url-check; no paid AI call
exceptions: Foreclosure, deed, auction and eviction are legal/process terms explained in nearby prose. Landlord and repairs are concrete housing terms; replacing them would obscure the purpose.
Massachusetts, ZIP and suite are place/address terms. Addresses, owner possessives, owns, sells and transfers include word forms whose base words may be in the frequency list.
Blank, leak and pests are concrete examples clearer than abstract substitutes; signature and Sincerely are conventional letter wording.
The remaining checker suggestion to omit There is does not identify a comprehension problem in the short instruction about the blank signing line.
